name: select
description: A dropdown control for choosing one option from a predefined fixed list.

select-trigger.purpose: Clickable trigger that opens the dropdown.

select-field.purpose: Complete form field with label, trigger, and description.

Selected.notes: No checkmark — selected state uses brand/primary text color only

invalid.notes: Uses [&[aria-invalid]] compound selector to beat data-[state=open]/focus-visible specificity. Blue ring must NOT appear when invalid.

accessibility.label: Use aria-labelledby pointing to label element.

constraints: Use select-field, not select-trigger, for standard form use.
Use select only for short, fixed, predetermined lists.
Use combobox for long, searchable, or multi-select lists.
Do not use select for boolean choices.
Open state must show the dropdown panel.
Invalid description must state the specific error.

useCases: Country or region field in a checkout or address form — fixed list, user needs to scroll and pick one
Timezone selector in account settings — short curated list, no typing required
Status or priority picker in a project tool: To Do, In Progress, Done, Blocked
Theme preference: Light, Dark, System — 3 options, no search needed
Role assignment in a user management form: Admin, Editor, Viewer

State=Default.whenToUse: Field rendered, no value chosen yet — placeholder shown
examples: Empty 'Select a country' on page load

State=Open.whenToUse: Actively showing the dropdown — use in mockups to preview the list
examples: Design spec showing dropdown with fruit options

State=Filled.whenToUse: A value has been selected and is displayed in the trigger
examples: 'United States' after user picks a country

State=Invalid.whenToUse: Form submitted without a required selection, or value fails validation

State=Disabled.whenToUse: Field is locked — context determines the value or user lacks permission to change it
examples: Read-only role display on a locked team member record

comparedTo.situation: Fixed short list (≤ ~10 items), pick one, no typing needed
Long list (10+ items) or user needs to search/filter
2–5 options where seeing all at once aids the decision
User may need to type a value not in the list

notes: Examples assume a SelectField wrapper API over shadcn Select primitives; source markdown itself does not mark this component not ready.

changelog.change: SelectItem: removed checkmark indicator. Selected state now uses color/brand/primary text (transparent bg) per spec. Container radius changed to radius/lg. Viewport padding p-0.5, gap-0.5 between items, item height h-8, px-2.

darkMode.notes: No known dark mode differences — all tokens are semantic and mode-aware.

notes: SelectItem: no checkmark indicator — selected state uses data-[state=checked]:text-[color/brand/primary] only.
Dropdown container uses radius/lg (not radius/md like trigger). Viewport uses p-0.5 + gap-0.5 flex-col layout.
